﻿# Fix Maven Compilation Failure: google-cloud-pubsublite 0.6.0 -> 1.6.3

## Context

Project `java-pubsub-group-kafka-connector` (by googleapis) has a **COMPILATION_FAILURE** after a dependency upgrade bot bumped
`com.google.cloud:google-cloud-pubsublite` from `0.6.0` to `1.6.3` (major update).

Reference PR: https://github.com/googleapis/java-pubsub-group-kafka-connector/pull/41

## Your Task

The source code is in `/java-pubsub-group-kafka-connector`. Fix all compilation errors so that `mvn compile` succeeds.
I'll analyze the compilation failure and fix it. Let me start by understanding the project structure and identifying the errors.

To instantiate `SinglePartitionPublisherBuilder`, use the static `newBuilder()` method and chain the required setters:

```java
Publisher<MessageMetadata> publisher = SinglePartitionPublisherBuilder.newBuilder()
    .setTopic(topicPath)
    .setPartition(partition)
    .setStreamFactory(streamFactory)
    .setBatchingSettings(batchingSettings)
    .build();
```

**Required builder methods:**
- `setTopic(TopicPath topic)` – the topic path
- `setPartition(Partition partition)` – the partition number
- `setStreamFactory(PublishStreamFactory streamFactory)` – the stream factory
- `setBatchingSettings(BatchingSettings batchingSettings)` – batching configuration

**Testing only:** `setUnderlyingBuilder(PublisherBuilder.Builder)` is marked `@VisibleForTesting`

The `build()` method returns `Publisher<MessageMetadata>` and may throw `ApiException`.
